name: Cart-Pole Balance
prompt: balance a pole on a cart

meta.name: Cart-Pole Balance
meta.tagline: Keep the pole upright by driving the cart.
meta.description: A pole balanced on a rolling cart starts almost upright. Push the cart left or right to catch the pole as it tips, and keep both the cart and pole within the track limits for as long as possible.

rewardTerms.description: Average pole-uprightness quality during the episode, scaled from 0 to 1.
Fraction of the maximum episode duration completed.
Fraction of steps spent pushing the cart.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Balance well and survive as long as possible.

presets.name: aggressive
presets.description: Prioritize keeping the pole upright, even with frequent corrections.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Favor lasting through the episode while avoiding excessive movement.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to push the cart.
